name: Amadeus Gas Pipeline
description: Carries gas from the Amadeus Basin fields near Alice Springs north to Darwin, the backbone of the NT gas network.

name: Palm Valley to Alice Springs
description: Lateral off the Amadeus system serving Alice Springs.

name: Mereenie to Tylers Pass
description: Feeder line from the Mereenie gas field to the Amadeus system via Tylers Pass.

name: Tennant Creek Lateral
description: Lateral off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) mainline serving Tennant Creek.

name: Katherine Lateral
description: Lateral off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) mainline serving Katherine.

name: Darwin Spur
description: Final spur off the Amadeus Gas Pipeline (AGP) into the Darwin LNG/port precinct.

name: Bayu/Undan to Darwin
description: Subsea pipeline carrying gas from the Bayu-Undan field in the Timor Sea to Darwin LNG.

name: Blacktip to Cosmo Howley
description: Subsea and onshore pipeline carrying gas from the offshore Blacktip field into the NT gas network.

name: Ichthys Gas Export Pipeline
description: Subsea pipeline carrying gas from the offshore Ichthys field in the Browse Basin to Ichthys LNG near Darwin.
